title: HeroHearts
description: A lightweight hardcore-style hearts system for Minecraft Paper and Purpur servers.
body:
# ❤️ Hero Hearts

A modern hardcore-inspired hearts system for Minecraft Paper/Purpur servers.

Hero Hearts adds a competitive survival mechanic where players have a limited number of lives (hearts). Every death removes one heart, and once a player reaches zero hearts, they are eliminated from the game world and sent to the lobby.

Perfect for:

* SMP servers
* Hardcore events
* PvP survival
* YouTube challenges
* Story-driven worlds
* Competitive multiplayer

---

# ✨ Features

## ❤️ Custom Heart/Life System

* Configurable starting hearts
* Per-player heart management
* Persistent player data storage

## ☠️ Elimination System

* Players lose 1 heart on death
* Players with 0 hearts are eliminated
* Eliminated players are teleported to the lobby world
* Prevent re-entering the game world

## 🌍 Multiverse Support

Works perfectly with Multiverse-Core.

Set:

* game worlds
* lobby worlds

directly using commands.

## ⚙️ Event Command Hooks

Run custom commands automatically when:

* a player loses a heart
* a player dies
* a player gets eliminated

Perfect for:

* Titles
* Sounds
* Announcements
* Cutscenes
* Game Over sequences
* Custom integrations

Example:

```yaml
onElimination:
  - "broadcast %player% has been eliminated!"
```

## 🛠️ Admin Commands

* `/hearts set`
* `/hearts add`
* `/hearts remove`
* `/hearts get`
* `/hearts reset`
* `/hearts setgameworld`
* `/hearts setlobbyworld`

## 💾 Persistent Data

Player hearts and elimination states are automatically saved.

---

# 📦 Requirements

* Paper or Purpur 1.17-1.21.x
* Java 17 and newer
* Multiverse-Core (recommended)
* Tested in Minecraft 1.21.10, 1.20.4 and 1.17.1

---

# 🚀 Planned Features

* Revival system
* Team hearts
* Spectator mode
* GUI management
* Database support
* PlaceholderAPI support
* Custom death penalties

---

# 📜 Permissions

```text
herohearts.admin
```
